allowed_changes: Replace the standalone audio and physical MIDI endpoint shell with a zero-input stereo VST3 processor that receives host buffers and host MIDI.
Expose the eleven source continuous controls plus desired Source, Lock, FX Mode, Target, and Scale as sixteen stable prototype-local host parameters.
Serialize only the complete sixteen-parameter program while resetting evolving capture, mutation, random, timeline, tail, gesture, diagnostic, MIDI-edge, and scope state on recall.
Represent Mutate and Freeze as non-persistent editor and raw-MIDI one-shots and never replay them during state restoration.
Use the existing Q27HostBridge to adapt arbitrary positive host callback lengths without resampling or changing source event quantization.
excluded: Host tempo synchronization, MIDI note triggering, sidechain or audio input, MIDI output, captured-buffer persistence, sample export, preset browser, and sample-rate conversion.
Other plug-in formats, universal or x86_64, Windows or Linux, installer, identity signing, notarization, packaging, public distribution, and production integration.
Ableton scan or workflow, callback deadlines, physical controller or endpoint behavior, listening approval, and canonical Schuss provider or runtime claims.
preserve: Exact Tide Pit signal graph, tables, algorithms, constants, update order, 48000-Hz rate, 16-frame source quantum, Q27 boundary, fixed seed, and per-instance random sequence.
Four stage controls, Rate, Memory, Material, Position, FX-A, FX-B, Root, their defaults and source curves, and the source soft-pickup behavior.
REED/RND/FOLD, Lock, CLEAN/FILT/DRIVE, PIT/BODY/GRAIN/ALL, MAJ5/MIN5/DOR/HARM, Mutate, Freeze, exact gesture durations, controller map, display text, accepted state, and known HARM mismatch.
Original source file bytes, shared Mutable package, generated defined-C++ voice overlay, retained bit-exact Q27 oracle, and existing standalone evidence.

intentional_deviations: The VST3 exposes five persistent desired mode values and reconciles them only through existing cyclic or toggle source actions.
Mutate and Freeze remain non-persistent one-shot actions so state recall cannot unexpectedly mutate or claim to restore captured audio.
State recall starts a fresh Core at seed 0x21 and restores only the complete parameter program; all evolving DSP and diagnostic state resets.
The processor rejects non-48000-Hz operation and unsupported layouts to exact silence rather than silently resampling or redesigning the source.
JUCE may add its standard bypass parameter and non-automatable VST3 MIDI-controller service parameters; they are wrapper protocol, not Tide Pit musical parameters.
